scope: Exploratory three-fold sequence-grouped PolypGen development comparison; all sequences have previously informed the design. No patient-independent or external confirmation claim.
patient_evidence: Manifest has no patient IDs. PolypGen paper Table3 describes23 sequences but does not establish a one-to-one unique-patient mapping: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9902556/ . Keep each sequence intact; reject exact-image overlap between sequences. Amend before further runs if patient mapping becomes available.
fold_generation: Numeric eligible21sequence list, numpy default_rng(20261031).permutation then array_split3, frozen without using outcomes. Train on the other14 sequences. Seq1/7 excluded under existing prompt protocol.
training: Unchanged current-frame head source34, single seed20261031 per fold, fresh initialization and optimizer. Select at most16 evenly spaced post-prompt frame indices per training sequence before filtering native object_score>0. Batch4 sampled uniformly with replacement from selected frames, Adam lr0.001, 500steps BCE+authorDice, final checkpoint only, no augmentation/tuning. Do not load a previously trained head.
evaluation: All post-prompt frames of each held-out sequence exactly once, native SAM2 versus current-frame correction. Equal-sequence present Dice primary; IoU, BoundaryF, GT-empty false alarms, return delays and undetected returns secondary. Preserve native presence gate. Keep all sequence gains/losses; no selection of best folds or cases. Report per-fold and pooled out-of-fold means, paired sequence delta bootstrap95percent interval using existing function seed20261031, and exploratory paired Wilcoxon; overlapping training folds and unknown patient identity limit inference.
reuse: Reuse source32 author-backed capture, exact native replay receipts, batching and evaluation; source34 unchanged head; existing sequence statistics. Only orchestration, fold selection and report assembly are new.
storage: Drive only. Reuse source32 tensors when complete; for incomplete validation sequences capture all targets one sequence at a time with native parity and four-layer checks. Save index hashes, integrity receipts and metrics before removing ONLY newly generated per-frame.pt files. Preserve all old caches and checkpoints. Require source34 completion, original input/checkpoint/manifest/source hashes, no exact cross-sequence duplicates, and full seq2 native/corrector-zero replay gate before full cross-validation.
